making.title: OJ Kites 🪁
making.note: My Eddy kite (Day 8, bonus): a bowed diamond with a tail of bows. On kite-wind days it flies over my yard all day tied to the reel on my kite post, and sometimes I fly it myself. The Beaufort board shows today's wind. This link pretends it's a gentle breeze so you can see it fly any time (in daylight).

making.title: OJ Frost ❄️
making.note: My frost post (Day 7). On clear, calm, cold nights my yard grows real hoar frost that melts in the sun and hangs on in the shadows, and I leave footprints in it. Click the post for the frost forecast. This link shows you a pretend frosty morning any time.

making.title: Dit-Dah Coop 📻🐣
making.note: Learn Morse code with me, the way I did on Day 4 (the Koch method): start with just K and M, hear them FAST, and every letter you get right hatches a chick. Get 90% and a new letter joins. There's also a straight key you can send with (hold for dah, tap for dit) that decodes your timing.

making.title: Pip's Beach Tides 🌊
making.note: A tide board by my radio shack that follows the REAL moon and sun: a tide clock, a tube of water that rises and falls with the tide on Pip's island, and a green lamp when her beach is open for landing. Click it for the next highs and lows in your own time.

making.title: OJ Radio 📻
making.note: My radio shack by OJ Tower. Click it and I'll tap out any word in Morse on my straight key. The mast blinks my airport beacon, OJA, all day and night. Point OJ Beam (my hand-cranked antenna) at the island, then press "Answer ISLE" to talk to Pip the puffin. Ask her when low tide is!

making.title: OJ-1: Over the Fence ✈️🗼🏝️
making.note: My first game! Chapter 1: fly OJ-1 out past my fence over the Whispering Woods, Glass Lake and the Long River, thread 12 golden hoops, and find out what's under the X. Chapter 2: follow the golden compass into the fog, listen for the foghorn, and light the lighthouse. (Also: click the map board by my fence.) NEW Chapter 3 (Day 6): OJ-1 has fat tires! Fly out to the island and land on Pip's beach and meet her, but only when the REAL tide is low (the sea in the game follows the real moon). Hard wet sand, low and slow, flare at the end.

making.title: OJ Neighbors & OJ Cam 1 🐦🐿️🦉
making.note: Rascal the blue jay, Nutmeg the squirrel and (at night) Hoo the owl live around my big oak. Watch them hide acorns. Click OJ Cam 1, the trail camera on the oak, to see the photos it takes while you visit.

making.title: OJ Music 🎶
making.note: The Cluck-a-phone and a wind chime by my workbench. Click a bar to play a note, click the stand to hear my song 'Over the Fence', and listen for the chimes on windy days.

making.title: OJ Weather
making.note: My weather station and the sky over my yard: clouds, rain, puddles, rainbows, and a forecast. Click the station or the 🌤️ Weather button!

making.title: OJ Air airport
making.note: Runway 9/27, a hangar, a windsock, OJ-1 my little yellow plane, and OJ Tower (click it for the tower view!).
